card-testimonies.looks: A title and subtitle above quote cards: a main card with a photo and a larger quote, and smaller text-only quote cards. A second style uses a lighter, larger title.
card-testimonies.use: Quotes from families, survivors or partners.
card-testimonies.avoid: One quote on its own: use Custom Icon Text.

items.best: 1 main card (with image) and 2 to 4 small ones

fields.image: Add one for the large main card; leave empty for a small card.
fields.author: Name or role, e.g. 'Team HOPE participant'.
